_authoringNotes: WO-1678 / HEART-005. THE ECHO EVENT TABLE. Every reward amount, duration, weight and
tier gate in the Heartbound event engine lives HERE and nowhere else - spec :947,
'All reward amounts and weights belong in data/config. No reward values hardcoded in
presentation classes.' api/_lib/heartbound-events.js contains no numeric reward literal.
TABLE VERSION IS PART OF THE SEED. Changing any row below without bumping tableVersion
would re-roll history: the same (pulseId, playerId, tableVersion) must return the same
event forever, and a player who already saw event X for pulse P must keep seeing X.
Bump tableVersion for ANY edit to rows[]; a bump is a NEW table, and old pulses keep
resolving against whichever version was recorded with them.
WEIGHT IS NOT A PROBABILITY FIELD. The roll is a deterministic hash-to-index over the
cumulative weight sum - the same inputs always land on the same row. No entropy, no
Math.random, no clock. The word 'weight' is deliberate; there is no 'chance', 'odds',
'probability', 'dropRate' or 'roll' field in this file, and HeartboundEventRegression
fails if one appears.
WHAT IS NOT IN THIS TABLE, AND WHY (owner rulings 2026-09-10 13:12 / 13:36):
* The dungeon-exclusive crafting ingredient event: DROPPED by ruling. Its supply is
owner-capped on both existing faucets and its only use is a weighted craft roll; a
staked position must not become a third faucet. It is not deferred - it is out.
* The visiting-vendor event: moved to its own work order (visiting-NPC lifecycle is a
feature in its own right; zero such lifecycle exists in the client today).
* Echo Bloom and Ancient Echo: deferred to the Heart-visual work order. A reveal card
that names a reward with no application behind it is worse than the row's absence.
They land with a tableVersion bump when their application seams exist.
NO ROW MAY EVER CARRY COMBAT POWER. Owner ruling Q-P2W 2026-09-10 13:10: economic
acceleration is allowed; combat power is not. kind is an ALLOW-LIST of four values and
the regression asserts it, so a row that moved a combat stat is a build failure rather
than a code review. The stat NAMES are deliberately not written anywhere in this file:
the lint that forbids them sweeps this text, and a note quoting one would fail the very
rule it was written to explain.

_rowNotes.resource_surge: One gathering structure produces faster for two hours. A MODIFIER only.
_rowNotes.crafting_inspiration: A crafting queue finishes sooner. Sells the WAIT, never a roll - it may never resolve a random outcome (JobRushPolicy).
_rowNotes.scout_whisper: Surfaces the EXISTING scout report EARLIER (ruled 2026-09-10 13:36). No new intel: no composition, no resistance, no recommended troop type. The information stays equal for every player; only the moment moves.
_rowNotes.echo_labor: Tier II identity. A pure NUMBER (ruled 2026-09-10 13:20): no world actors, no second Echo spawner. The Echo appearance owner stays the one owner.
_rowNotes.heartfire_spark: The ONE ruled second source of Heartfire (2026-09-10 13:12), capped at one charge, never purchasable, clamped at the pool ceiling. Rarest row on purpose.
